period_note: Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Condensed Balance Sheet (Unaudited)'/'Condensed Profit and Loss Account (Unaudited)' (distinct from the 'Condensed Consolidated' statements printed earlier in the same filing) — chosen per this project's stated preference for Solo over Consolidated wherever both are available. Matches the basis of this bank's 2012-2016 and 2021-2025 solo series (2020 Q4/annual is Consolidated per that entry's own note, so do not compare this quarter's absolute levels directly against 2020_Q4.json without adjusting for the bKash/subsidiary consolidation effect). Paid-up capital rose from BDT 12,334m (Q1 2020) to BDT 13,259m: a 7.5% stock dividend for FY2019 (925,031,490 new shares, funded by capitalizing retained earnings) was approved at the 21st AGM (25 June 2020) and is fully reflected in the Statement of Changes in Equity — a genuine capital-structure event, not a restatement. Income-statement items use the 'Cumulative Jan to Sep 2020' column; the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended Jul to Sep 2020' column (interest income 5,572,155,644; PAT 1,276,587,408; EPS 0.96) not recorded here as line items. Balance sheet identity reconciles to within BDT 1 million (rounding): Total property and assets 389,630,921,358 vs Total liabilities 346,480,167,523 + Total shareholders' equity 43,150,753,836 = 389,630,921,359. Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly in raw Taka. Solo Key Financial Ratios (note 6.3, annualized) give car_pct/roa_pct/roe_pct directly; no NPL% or cost-income ratio is disclosed anywhere in this filing. COVID-19/regulatory finding: note 4.3 states 'both the consolidated and standalone EPS decreased in 2020 as lower profit earned due to the effect of COVID-19 pandemic and the implementation of 9% interest rate cap on loans and advances as per BRPD circulars, [but] increased compared to third quarter of 2019 because of higher investment income earned from government securities, repo transactions and reversal of capital market provision'; note 2.2 confirms adequate provisioning was made per Bangladesh Bank circulars 'in force including recent BRPD circulars up to September 2020' — no separate NPL/asset-quality or moratorium-specific disclosure beyond this.
